bestBets.overview: Racing in Brisbane on Saturday takes place at Doomben where we have 10 races on the card, the action gets underway nice & early just after 11am. Track rated a soft (5) at scratching time this morning however with a fine day ahead expect a swift upgrade. The 3 & 4yo's tackle a mile here in the opener & I'm with the topweight WRIGLEY FIELD who has raced over 1400m all three runs this prep & looks to be busting to get out over further. Well, today's the day & from the gate he should land a soft run.

raceTips.comment: WRIGLEY FIELD got back and worked home strongly into fourth over the 1350m last start. At peak fitness, he’ll relish the rise in trip and gate four can see him settle within striking distance. BONEWOOD has made the trip down from Rockhampton. Lightly raced, he’s shown talent and with the blinkers back on and just 49.5kgs on his back, I think he can run a big race. DUST CLOUD has won two of his past three starts and looks to have a bright future. It was a dominant win last time over the mile and with even luck form the wide gate, he’ll be strong at the finish.
